The complete items field is selected unchanged; no item-member narrowing or replacement summary appears.

The source supports term plus independent optional presence/values for request construction, and total plus the whole items field for the response outputs. Selected tool contracts express these inputs, but their erroneous review rejections and the global prohibition gap prevent a complete necessity result.

review_error.assessment: The source explicitly requires optional inclusion/omission and unchanged values. Both selected paired contracts correctly encode value/from_date and value/limit with if_present=true. The frozen transfer automatically emits the corresponding presence demand before retaining the value only when present. Therefore the review claim that these contracts omit presence preservation is incorrect. A separately authored presence selector would be redundant for this flag.
review_error.actual_effect: The rejected receipt is honored by the actual run, producing five input_contract_rejected diagnostics. The run did not apply the accepted if_present transfer for these rejected contracts. No post-hoc approval or recomputation is performed.
review_error.scope_limit: This finding concerns the stated presence-preservation rejection. It is not a claim of universal semantic correctness or complete DOE.
